clips.title: The story
paras: Alaric's bones lie in a shallow grave in Silverpine Forest, far from Fenris Isle. His spirit asks travelers to carry them past the Rot Hide gnolls and directly into Fenris Keep.

Alaric's bones were unearthed from a shallow grave in Silverpine Forest. He was once a resident of Fenris Isle, and his spirit longs for the place he cherished in life. He asks whoever finds his bones to leave his ill-fitting boots behind and carry his remains directly into Fenris Keep, far from the scavengers prowling the mainland.
